scenes.tts: Is the line really a source? Add it somewhere new, and watch what the neighbours do.
scenes.visual: Visual language: one flat strip of neural tube, front at left; slate Otx2, sage Gbx2, gold Fgf8, clay Wnt1. Title card: One Bead Builds a Midbrain. The strip with its gold and clay bands at the line.
scenes.narration: Is the line really a source? Add it somewhere new, and watch what the neighbours do.

scenes.tts: A factor is sufficient if adding it where it is normally absent produces the structure.
scenes.visual: Icon: add it. Definition card: sufficient means adding it where it is normally absent produces the structure.
scenes.narration: A factor is sufficient if adding it where it is normally absent produces the structure.

scenes.tts: First, tissue. Alvarado-Mallart's group often grafted quail brain into chick embryos, since quail cells look different under the microscope.
scenes.visual: Two embryo outlines, quail and chick. Quail nuclei drawn dotted, chick nuclei plain.
scenes.narration: First, tissue. Alvarado-Mallart's group often grafted quail brain into chick embryos, since quail cells look different under the microscope.

scenes.tts: In nineteen ninety-one, Martinez, Wassef and Alvarado-Mallart moved tissue from just behind the junction into the forebrain.
scenes.caption: In 1991, Martínez, Wassef and Alvarado-Mallart moved tissue from just behind the junction into the forebrain.
scenes.visual: A dotted piece from just behind the junction is placed into a chick forebrain. Credit: Martínez, Wassef and Alvarado-Mallart, 1991.
scenes.narration: In 1991, Martínez, Wassef and Alvarado-Mallart moved tissue from just behind the junction into the forebrain.

scenes.tts: Forebrain cells next to the graft turned on Engrailed. Later they developed as midbrain. The junction could instruct its neighbours.
scenes.visual: Plain host cells next to the graft turn Engrailed blue; the dotted graft cells stay put. Later the blue host tissue takes a midbrain shape.
scenes.narration: Forebrain cells next to the graft turned on Engrailed. Later they developed as midbrain. The junction could instruct its neighbours.

scenes.tts: What was the message? In nineteen ninety-six, Crossley, Martinez and Gail Martin soaked beads in F G F eight. They placed them in the diencephalon, the back of the forebrain. An extra midbrain formed.
scenes.caption: What was the message? In 1996, Crossley, Martínez and Gail Martin soaked beads in FGF8. They placed them in the diencephalon, the back of the forebrain. An extra midbrain formed.
scenes.visual: A bead soaked in gold FGF8 sits in the diencephalon; Engrailed comes on around it and an extra midbrain shape forms. Credit: Crossley, Martínez and Martin, 1996.
scenes.narration: What was the message? In 1996, Crossley, Martínez and Gail Martin soaked beads in FGF8. They placed them in the diencephalon, the back of the forebrain. An extra midbrain formed.

scenes.tts: Predict. The real midbrain still has its own isthmus behind it. Which way will the new midbrain face?
scenes.visual: Question card over the strip showing the bead and the real isthmus: Which way will the new midbrain face?
scenes.narration: Predict. The real midbrain still has its own isthmus behind it. Which way will the new midbrain face?

scenes.tts: It was built in reverse, a mirror image. Parts that normally lie nearest the isthmus formed nearest the bead.
scenes.visual: The new midbrain fills in with its parts labelled back and front: the back label next to the bead, the front label farther away. Label: mirror image.
scenes.narration: It was built in reverse, a mirror image. Parts that normally lie nearest the isthmus formed nearest the bead.

scenes.tts: One source is enough to reverse the order. Here is a toy model, with made-up numbers, with a second source behind it: the bead and the real isthmus send out the same signal.
scenes.visual: Two sources on the strip, the bead and the real isthmus, each with fading gold rings. Below, a plot of signal against position: two falling curves, one from each source. Label: toy model, illustrative numbers.
scenes.narration: One source is enough to reverse the order. Here is a toy model, with made-up numbers, with a second source behind it: the bead and the real isthmus send out the same signal.

scenes.tts: A cell cannot tell which source a molecule came from. It gets the sum. The sum falls from the bead to the midpoint, then rises toward the real isthmus.
scenes.visual: The two curves add into one total curve, drawn above them and shaded: high at the bead, lowest at the midpoint, high again at the real isthmus. A dashed line marks the midpoint.
scenes.narration: A cell cannot tell which source a molecule came from. It gets the sum. The sum falls from the bead to the midpoint, then rises toward the real isthmus.

scenes.tts: In a normal midbrain, cells near the isthmus get the most signal, and they build the back parts. Cells next to the bead get a lot too. So they build back parts as well.
scenes.visual: Midbrain-part labels settle by signal: a back label next to the bead and a back label next to the real isthmus. Hold on these two labels.
scenes.narration: In a normal midbrain, cells near the isthmus get the most signal, and they build the back parts. Cells next to the bead get a lot too. So they build back parts as well.

scenes.tts: Farther from the bead, the signal falls, so the parts run toward front of midbrain. Between the bead and the midpoint, the order runs the wrong way round.
scenes.visual: The remaining labels fill in: front near the midpoint, then front to back again toward the real isthmus. The reversed stretch between the bead and the midpoint is outlined. Label: mirror image.
scenes.narration: Farther from the bead, the signal falls, so the parts run toward front of midbrain. Between the bead and the midpoint, the order runs the wrong way round.

scenes.tts: One caution. The tissue around the bead switched on Engrailed two, and in later bead experiments its own F G F eight and Wint one. That induced organizer probably helped pattern the midbrain too.
scenes.caption: One caution. The tissue around the bead switched on Engrailed-2, and in later bead experiments its own FGF8 and Wnt1. That induced organizer probably helped pattern the midbrain too.
scenes.visual: Gold and clay bands light up in the host tissue around the bead. Label: an induced, isthmus-like organizer (Fgf8 and Wnt1 from later bead work); the bead's gradient alone not shown.
scenes.narration: One caution. The tissue around the bead switched on Engrailed-2, and in later bead experiments its own FGF8 and Wnt1. That induced organizer probably helped pattern the midbrain too.

scenes.tts: Predict. In the nineteen ninety-six experiment, the bead made midbrain. But F G F eight normally comes from the side that builds cerebellum. Why midbrain?
scenes.caption: Predict. In the 1996 experiment, the bead made midbrain. But FGF8 normally comes from the side that builds cerebellum. Why midbrain?
scenes.visual: Question card: FGF8 comes from the cerebellum side. Why did the 1996 bead make midbrain? The bead sits on a slate background.
scenes.narration: Predict. In the 1996 experiment, the bead made midbrain. But FGF8 normally comes from the side that builds cerebellum. Why midbrain?

scenes.tts: The diencephalon is forebrain, so its cells carry O T X two and can respond. At this dose, the response was midbrain. Whether the response is midbrain or cerebellum also depends on the strength and duration of F G F eight.
scenes.caption: The diencephalon is forebrain, so its cells carry Otx2 and can respond. At this dose, the response was midbrain. Whether the response is midbrain or cerebellum also depends on the strength and duration of FGF8.
scenes.visual: The same gold rings shown twice on the roof of the tube: on slate Otx2 tissue, midbrain forms; on the sage Gbx2 roof of rhombomere 1, cerebellum forms. Small note: responsive tissue only; dose and timing matter.
scenes.narration: The diencephalon is forebrain, so its cells carry Otx2 and can respond. At this dose, the response was midbrain. Whether the response is midbrain or cerebellum also depends on the strength and duration of FGF8.

scenes.tts: With a strong or lasting source, the rule bends. In later bead experiments, F G F eight switched O T X two off and G B X two on. Then isthmus and cerebellum-like tissue formed.
scenes.caption: With a strong or lasting source, the rule bends. In later bead experiments, FGF8 switched Otx2 off and Gbx2 on. Then isthmus and cerebellum-like tissue formed.
scenes.visual: Text note beside a large gold source: in later bead experiments, FGF8 switched Otx2 off and Gbx2 on. Credit: Martínez and colleagues, 1999.
scenes.narration: With a strong or lasting source, the rule bends. In later bead experiments, FGF8 switched Otx2 off and Gbx2 on. Then isthmus and cerebellum-like tissue formed.

scenes.tts: Takeaway: the line is a source. The signal tells a cell which part. The repressor sets which region it can become.
scenes.visual: Closing card: A line becomes a source. Signal: which part. Repressor: which region it can become.
scenes.narration: Takeaway: the line is a source. The signal tells a cell which part. The repressor sets which region it can become.
